Contact Us

General health check-up clinic

Phayathai 1 Hospital, Building 3, 4th Floor

Office hours

Open daily from 07.00 a.m.- 04.00 p.m.

 

Tel

(+66)2-201-4600 ext. 2149

Phyathai 1 firmly believes health is a fundamental root of all happiness. Our Health Check-up Center offers a wide range of exceptional services to suit individual needs. Our professional and attentive staff are happy to assist you in gaining an insightful look at your health.

 

Phyathai 1 Hospital Health Check-up Center provides exceptional medical services to our valued customers. This center offers various unique check-up packages to suit a wide range of patient needs. One of these specific check-up packages includes a medical check-up in a particular age group, for pre-employment, before going abroad, an annual medical check-up for executives and their employees, and our special onsite check-up for an all-in-one point service which is maintained by the measurement of ministerial regulations.

 

What Are the Benefits of Checkups? Regular checkups with your healthcare provider can benefit your health in many ways. Some of the key benefits include: finding potentially life-threatening health issues early before they cause a problem early treatment of health conditions, which increases the odds of a good outcome regular monitoring of existing health issues, which lowers the risk of worsening symptoms or severe complications staying up-to-date on vaccinations and screening tests limiting extra healthcare costs associated with treating severe or complicated conditions that aren’t caught early developing and maintaining an open, honest relationship with your primary care physician (PCP) learning new ways to live a healthy, longer life and improving your health

 

Clinics & Services

Annual check-up service
Medical check-up for insurance
Onsite medical check-up service
Pre-employment check-up and check-up for going abroad
Medical check-up for Medical Certificate
With Phyathai 1 Health Check-up Center’s extensive list of check-up choices, patients can select the health programs that best benefit them with the help of our experienced team of doctors and our modern medical technologies.
